header.title: Training Session 0: Orientation (5 minutes). Press Space to start

items.notes: Trainer: everyone on the team takes this one. Press Space to start the first video, and Space again when it ends.
A short video. It plays with sound on the projector screen. When it ends, press Space to move on.
The trainer's script for each slide is in the slide's own notes.

text.title: Try it now
text.body:
Try it now:
press Ctrl+\ (⌘\ on a Mac) to go to Plan.
Find this service under Training.
Press it again to come back here.

items.notes: Let the trainee switch to Plan and back. The service stays open for live while they look.

header.title: Done. Next: Training Session 1, Run a service

items.notes: Close the service with Close service, bottom right, or open Training Session 1 straight away.
